_about: Supervisor entries of the mobile-bot add-on. The installer merges them into the registry on --with-mobile-bot. only_if_exists keeps a machine without the add-on at 0 problems + 0 broken. __CLAUDE_DIR__ and __HOME__ are filled when the registry is read.

checks.name: Mobile bot: the safety gate holds
checks.note: functional: a secret read and rm -rf are blocked under CLAUDE_MOBILE_BOT=1, a plain read passes; hooks present and executable; the bot switches the flag on. Add `--user <bot user>` to the cmd when the bot runs as another account and the supervisor runs as root.

checks.name: Mobile bot: service is running
checks.note: the unit written by setup-mobile-bot.sh; a stopped bot means the phone cannot reach the agent
